review_scope: Only the 27 source-matched PNGs explicitly added to the synchronized bundled manifests in this phase.
criteria: PNG displays as a non-empty character/render composition.
No obvious decode corruption or severe unintended truncation is visible.
Large props, vehicles, effects, or wide framing are not rejected solely for being unusual when they are part of the rendered composition.
limitations: This is a visual integrity screen, not pixel-perfect reproduction certification.
Visual appearance is not used to infer a semantic torso/core axis.
Source identity is established by canonical resource mapping and pinned skeleton/atlas provenance, not by visual guesswork.
